title: Trust-But-Verify: Poisoning-Resilient Locally Private Graph Learning Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2609.07063v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Built upon local differential privacy (LDP), locally private graph learning protocols have emerged as an important paradigm for decentralized graph learning, balancing privacy protection and learning utility. Under such protocols, each user locally perturbs their node features and adjacency information before transmission, ensuring formal privacy guarantees without original data leaving the device. However, the inherently open participation nature renders these protocols critically vulnerable to data poisoning attacks, where adversaries inject carefully crafted malicious nodes to corrupt neighborhood aggregation and degrade downstream utility. Despite the severity of this threat, effective defenses in this setting remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose VERITAS, a poisoning-resilient locally private graph learning protocol built on a trust-but-verify paradigm. translated_title: 信任但要验证：抗投毒的本地私有图学习协议
translated_abstract: 基于本地差分隐私（LDP）构建的本地私有图学习协议已成为去中心化图学习的重要范式，在隐私保护与学习效用之间实现了平衡。在此类协议下，每个用户在传输前对自身的节点特征和邻接信息进行本地扰动，在原始数据不离开设备的情况下提供正式的隐私保证。然而，其固有的开放参与特性使这些协议极易遭受数据投毒攻击——攻击者通过注入精心构造的恶意节点来破坏邻域聚合并降低下游学习效用。尽管这一威胁十分严重，但针对该场景的有效防御在很大程度上仍待探索。本文提出了VERITAS，一种基于“信任但要验证”范式的抗投毒本地私有图学习协议。通过引入一个编码分级同伴信任等级的验证列表……
tldr: 本文提出VERITAS，一种基于“信任但要验证”范式的抗投毒本地私有图学习协议，通过分级同伴信任验证机制有效抵御数据投毒攻击，在保护隐私的同时维持图学习效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VERITAS, a poisoning-resilient locally private graph learning protocol built on a trust-but-verify paradigm, which defends against data poisoning attacks through graded peer trust verification while preserving privacy and learning utility.
